implementationAdapters: React JSX syntax and event/data bindings only; no iframe or new visual design.
Replace static existing-room/current-chart preview contents with current live AtelierScene/Inset/Astrolabe3D in same stage geometry; never remount scene on rail switch.
Convert embedded font/art URLs to bundled equivalent byte-identical local files when required; preserve fonts/tokens/spacing.
Account avatar uses actual identity32px inside44px target; default anonymous icon conveys no fabricated account.
Interaction sounds controls only existing natally.atelier.sound-muted foley gate; never claims to mute hardcoded AtelierAmbience.
Pause motion uses existing AppShell paused/setPaused→ReadingStage→AtelierScene motionEnabled.
Native browser bridge uses same actual phone/code widgets and stable IDs/security protocol; native stage omitted only on external bridge.
Provider-owned checkout/reCAPTCHA are actual external widgets and cannot be faithfully faked by prototype HTML.
Measured visual viewport/native safe-area adaptation may change available size; no hierarchy or semantic changes.

All app entries including legacy landing.html/src/landing/main.tsx resolve to canonical frozen AppShell frame; preserve purchased-domain roles/query auth handoff/displayVersion and leave retired marketing source unchanged.

Birthplace suggestion popup is existing native datalist; exported option reference shows actual gazetteer Toronto data. Platform native popup appearance is an explicit idiosyncrasy; preserve the exported confirmed-place chip structure.

S09-retained concrete report DOM/facts/chart/17sections/actions is generated by existing buildReport from public EXAMPLE_BIRTH and captured AstroChart, only for design reference. Production replaces reference values with actual retained record and omits data-prototype-only reference labels, never invents purchases.
BirthDateFields preserves existing YYYY/MM/DD typed input, current-month/day grid and actual year chooser; native select/picker appearance is a documented platform adaptation.
dynamicDataPolicy: Templates intentionally contain empty data-bind regions or honest loading. Services fill actual identity, amounts, chart facts, transcript, report, errors and operation results. Prototype never simulates service completion.

renderedDimensions.note: Provider retains stale original desktop metadata after update_screen; actual PNG dimensions are authoritative.

initialInsetGeometry.manualGeometry: Keep existing drag/resize/dock behavior and per-account persistence. These defaults apply only before manual/restored geometry; no replacement movement system.
